notes: Listed untested means public facts only: nothing was run.
Hosting references are a reference server price in EUR, not a total and not a measurement.
Each option shows up to 2 claims; its record page lists them all.

description.untrusted_excerpt: Tracks tasks and bugs, plans team work in short timed cycles, and manages product roadmaps, with shared notes pages and progress charts.

footprint.sentence: Its compose file names these supporting services: postgres, rabbitmq, valkey. Our rough heuristic, not the project's stated minimum: a medium server (4 vCPU, 8 GB RAM), for example Hetzner CPX32 at €35.99 a month excl. VAT (checked 2026-10-13). Check the project's own requirements; this leaves out the time it takes you to run it.

body.order_note: Options are in the order the goal page lists them: by evidence label, then by whether the project is maintained, then by GitHub-star band, then by name. The order is not a judgment of quality, and no vendor can pay for inclusion, position or label.
